How this site got the way it is, newest first. The entry says what changed; beside a few, a note says why, in the maker’s hand. “Considered options” opens what else was on the table.

  1. 2026-11-04

    A shelf, not a sermon

    First page up: a scroll of five posts, two kinds of proof. The name has a swear in it, so the first screen has to read as a gift rather than a rant.

    considered options
    • aThe scrollSmallest honest page, and it leaves the chart-first version available later with no rework.
      Name, one promise line, posts newest first. Five posts and the page is real; adding one is appending a block.
    • bManifesto over stream
      Three or four paragraphs on what the site is for, then the stream. Rejected: the words have to be JC's, and a manifesto written for him is exactly the rant a stranger already expects.
    • cChart as the front door
      One long-run chart fills the first screen. Strongest first impression, but it fixes the register as a data site before anything has been posted in the other three types. Held as the next move.
    I kind of feel like something needs to go up before Saturday. To fulfill my role, my commitment to myself.
    JC, 11/4
